evidence: The claimed step S0002 asserts that (40a) implies H (no M in class with S_M(n) <= s(n)^c and tau_M(n) <= s(n)^d for all sufficiently large n), but does not establish the critical class match needed to connect H to P!=NP via MMW Thm 1.3. Specifically: (1) (40a) quantifies over uniform deterministic one-pass RAM algorithms WITHOUT oracle access during computation (M_{s,A}^plain class), as stated in the manuscript page 8 section 8.1. (2) MMW Thm 1.3 quantifies over ALL exact staged Boolean realizations (not only those with canonical or linear states), which is a broader class that may include nonuniform and oracle-assisted computations. (3) The recorded gap G-new explicitly notes: 'class M^unif_{s,A} contains every algorithm MMW Thm 1.3 quantifies over' is open. (4) Without establishing that the (40a) quantified class is subset-of or equal to MMW's quantified class, the implication (40a) => H => P!=NP is unvalidated. The proof is therefore incomplete as stated - it assumes what needs to be proved regarding class inclusion.
